title_en: Can You Put Sports Into an ETF Yet?
title_zh: 体育能装进 ETF 了吗？
subtitle_zh: 从 NHL 32 只球队 ETF 到 Subversive 主动博彩基金，Bloomberg Intelligence 分析师解读体育与 ETF 融合的最新申报浪潮。
summary_zh: 本期 Trillions 由 Joel Weber 主持，嘉宾是 Bloomberg Intelligence ETF 分析师 Athanasios Psarofagis（Ethan），聚焦体育与 ETF 融合的最新申报。Volatility Shares 提交了 32 只挂钩 NHL 球队的 ETF，每队一只，用 CME 已上市的期货跟踪官方比赛数据，方法论包含 55 个输入指标。两人讨论了这类产品可能面临的流动性不足、休赛期空窗、期货移仓成本等问题，以及相较 Kalshi、Polymarket 等预测市场 App，ETF 到底能带来什么优势。也谈到另外两类申报：基于预测市场的二元型 ETF（如 Super Bowl 冠军、Fed 决议、经济衰退等），以及 Subversive All-Season Sports ETF——一只由基金经理替你下注的主动管理型基金，Eric Balchunas 把它比作电影《Casino》里的 Sam Rothstein。节目最后讨论了牛市高点期实验性 ETF 集中涌现的现象、SEC'不做评判'的监管姿态，以及 Z 世代把体育博彩视为资产类别的趋势。
description: Can You Put Sports Into an ETF Yet?

turns.en: Bloomberg Audio Studios. Podcasts. Radio. News. This is basically betting on how well the team is going to do. So in a way, it's just like sports betting, but betting on the strength of these teams. I think looking at it through the lens of stock picking, essentially, and you're basically just team picking here.
turns.zh: Bloomberg Audio Studios. Podcasts. Radio. News. 这基本上就是在押注球队会有多好的表现。所以从某种意义上说，这跟体育博彩没什么两样，只不过是在赌这些球队的实力。我觉得本质上是从选股的视角来看，只不过你在这里选的是球队。

turns.en: Welcome to Trillions. I'm Joel Weber.
turns.zh: 欢迎收听 Trillions，我是 Joel Weber。

turns.en: I'm Athanasios Saravagas.
turns.zh: 我是 Athanasios Psarofagis。

turns.en: There are a bunch of new ETF filings this year that have been all about sports. And now there's even more. There's some new research from Bloomberg Intelligence about volatility shares, which is filed for 32 funds using CME futures that will be linked to official NHL performance data. 32 funds because there are 32 teams in the NHL. Every team... could potentially have its own ETF. Hope you like hockey. But that's not all. This year, we're seeing this convergence of the sports world and the ETF universe. One biggie to watch, prediction market ETFs, which were filed earlier this year. We've talked about them on previous episodes if you want to go deeper. One that we haven't talked about as much, another sports-related ETF filing with its own unique twist, the subversive all-season sports ETF, which is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that aims to basically just win a bunch of sports bets. Nothing is actually approved yet here. These are all just filings. But clearly, sports betting and prediction market apps have shown ETF issuers what can happen when you do this base well. The question, though, is also, why do this in an ETF? Eric Balchunas is off for this episode, so we've tapped one of our favorite ETF regulars on Trillions, Athanasios Saraphagos, is an analyst with Bloomberg Intelligence on Eric's team. We'll be filling in for him. Ethan, pleasure to have you back on Trillions.
turns.zh: 今年出现了一大堆跟体育相关的 ETF 申报文件，而现在还有更多。Bloomberg Intelligence 有一份新的研究报告，讲的是 Volatility Shares 提交了 32 只基金的申报，这些基金会用 CME 期货来跟踪 NHL 官方比赛数据。为什么是 32 只？因为 NHL 有 32 支球队。每支球队……都可能拥有自己的 ETF。希望你喜欢冰球。但这还不是全部。今年我们看到体育界和 ETF 圈正在融合。一个值得关注的大方向是预测市场 ETF，年初就已经提交了申报。我们之前的节目聊过，如果你想深入了解可以去翻。另一个我们聊得比较少、但同样跟体育相关、还带有独特玩法的 ETF 申报，是 Subversive All-Season Sports ETF，这是一只主动管理型交易所交易基金，目标说白了就是——赢一大堆体育赌注。目前这些东西都还没被批准，全都只是申报文件。但显然，体育博彩和预测市场类 App 已经让 ETF 发行商看到，如果你把这个用户群体经营好，能带来多大的机会。不过问题也在于，为什么非要用 ETF 来做这件事？Eric Balchunas 这期节目不在，所以我们请来了 Trillions 上我们最喜欢的 ETF 常客之一——Athanasios Psarofagis，他是 Bloomberg Intelligence 的分析师，在 Eric 的团队里，这次由他来顶替。Ethan，很高兴你再次做客 Trillions。

turns.en: Thanks for having me back on.
turns.zh: 谢谢你们再次邀请我。

turns.en: This time on Trillions, the sports conversions. So, Ethan, one of the things that's been happening with ETFs this year has been a number of filings that are all sports related. And we've talked about a little bit of that before, but now there's a whole new range of filings that just hit. So I want to discuss those with you today, as well as the rest of the space. What's in these newest filings?
turns.zh: 这一期 Trillions 的主题是体育融合。Ethan，今年 ETF 圈发生的一件事就是出现了大量跟体育相关的申报文件。这些我们之前稍微聊过一点，但最近又冒出了一大批新的申报。今天我想跟你聊聊这些新的申报，以及整个领域其他的情况。这些最新的申报文件里到底是什么内容？

turns.en: So these new ones, basically, think about it like stock picking, but you can actually bet on an NHL team. And it's not like betting if they're going to win or lose a game. It's literally betting on the strength of the team. So if you think like the Rangers are going to have a good year, you can actually buy the Rangers ETF You have.
turns.zh: 这些新的申报文件，说白了，你可以把它想象成选股，但你可以真的去押注一支 NHL 球队。这不是赌他们某场比赛输赢，而是实实在在押注球队的整体实力。所以如果你觉得 Rangers 今年会打得不错，你可以直接买 Rangers ETF——你得先……

turns.en: To care about the NHL, first of all. That's the prerequisite. Yeah.
turns.zh: 首先得关心 NHL。这是前提。对。

turns.en: You definitely need to know about hockey, which I admittedly don't know that much about hockey. But they picked these because there's already some futures that launched on the CME that are tied to these. And I think if these do well, we likely could see the other leagues come in, NBA and NFL. But this is what they're starting with. 32 different ETFs, 32 different teams. Again, it's sort of just looking at the team like you're looking at a stock, their roster, maybe, you know, with their schedules coming up, you know, if they have momentum, all that, and you can just bet on it, or you can even short it, right? So let's say you like the Rangers, but hate the Canucks, or so you can actually just short and play different spreads. But yeah, it's this convergence of sports betting and ETFs that is now sort of all coming together.
turns.zh: 你确实需要懂冰球，说实话我对冰球了解得不多。但他们选 NHL 是因为 CME 上已经有一些跟这些球队挂钩的期货在交易了。我觉得如果这些 ETF 表现不错，接下来很可能会看到 NBA 和 NFL 也进来。但他们是从 NHL 开始的，32 只不同的 ETF，32 支不同的球队。同样地，这就像你在看一只股票那样看球队——他们的阵容、接下来的赛程、有没有势头之类的，你可以直接下注，甚至可以放空，对吧？比如说你喜欢 Rangers，讨厌 Canucks，你就可以做空 Canucks 来做各种价差交易。所以说，这就是体育博彩和 ETF 现在正在融合到一起的趋势。

turns.en: Okay, Ethan, what's actually in this ETF? I mean, these are filings, right? So nothing's real yet. But like what would you own if you were to purchase a share of this?
turns.zh: 好的 Ethan，这只 ETF 里面到底是什么？我是说这些都还是申报阶段，对吧？所以还没落地。但如果你买一股的话，你到底持有什么？

turns.en: I think you own nothing, right? Because what's interesting, there are stocks out there that you could buy shares in a sports team, right? Like Manchester United or the Braves even. So you actually like have claimed ticket sales and things like that and you could benefit from it.
turns.zh: 我觉得你其实什么都没持有，对吧？有意思的地方在于，市面上已经有一些股票可以让你直接买体育球队的股份，比如 Manchester United，甚至 Atlanta Braves。这样你其实是拥有门票销售之类的收益分成，球队表现好你也能受益。

turns.en: There's like revenue that you can capture.
turns.zh: 也就是能捕捉到实际的营收。

turns.en: Totally. So if the team does well or you can even buy stock in MSG, right? And that's not just the Knicks. But if they do well and ticket sales go up, you have a piece of that. This is basically betting on how well the team is going to do. So in a way, it's just like sports betting, but betting on the strength of these teams. So if you like changes they made in the off season, or if you think they have a week schedule coming up, you can actually buy the team that you like. I think looking at it through the lens of like stock picking, essentially, and you're basically just team picking here.
turns.zh: 完全对。球队打得好你就受益，或者你甚至可以买 MSG 的股票，对吧？MSG 不只有 Knicks。但如果他们打得好，门票销量上去了，你就有一份收益。这些 NHL ETF 本质上是在押注球队会有多好的表现。所以从某种意义上说，这跟体育博彩没什么两样，只不过是在赌这些球队的实力。如果你喜欢他们在休赛期做的调整，或者觉得他们接下来的赛程比较轻松，你就可以直接买你喜欢的球队。我觉得本质上是从选股的视角来看，只不过你在这里选的是球队。

turns.en: What do we need to know about futures-based ETFs?
turns.zh: 关于基于期货的 ETF，我们需要了解什么？

turns.en: I think one thing to think about with these is, illiquidity, right? Like if they're not going to be really popular, you know, how are market makers going to handle these? Two, what happens like the off season, right? So, you know, they don't play- Oh, Stanley Cup, what's going down? So, you know, obviously there's news that comes out, there's trades and they can move in that, but it's going to be a couple of months of it just doing nothing. And then obviously with futures, there's roll costs. These are going to roll every month. They're going to reset at the end of the season. So there's spreads in there that you have to know Or be cognizant of. But that said, I honestly don't know how these would behave. This is literally a new area of the market. So, you know, how someone might hedge this, how it might be formed. Maybe just the bigger team ones have more interest in some of the smaller ones. But yeah, it's definitely going to be pretty interesting to see how these... It also.
turns.zh: 我觉得首先要考虑的是流动性不足的问题。如果这些 ETF 不是很受欢迎，做市商要怎么处理？第二，休赛期怎么办？他们不打比赛了……噢，Stanley Cup 正在打！所以说，休赛期显然还是会有新闻、有球员交易，价格会有波动，但会有好几个月基本没什么动静。然后期货本身还有移仓成本，这些 ETF 每个月都要移仓，赛季结束还要重置。所以里面是有价差的，你得清楚或者留意到。话虽如此，说实话我也不知道这些东西实际会怎么表现。这真的是一块全新的市场领域。大家会怎么对冲、怎么组建仓位？可能只有大球队的 ETF 关注度会高一些，小球队的会冷清。总之，看看这些 ETF 会怎么走肯定挺有意思的……另外还……

turns.en: Seems kind of complicated. Like, why not just use a bookie or a sports betting app or... A prediction market app, you know, like why do we need an ETF for this?
turns.zh: 听起来还挺复杂的。为什么不直接找庄家、用体育博彩 App 或者……预测市场 App？我们干嘛非得用 ETF 来做这件事？

turns.en: Yeah, we debate this on the team all the time. And normally when you think about the success of an ETF, it's because it's made something easier, right? It's giving you access to crypto or bonds in Latin America or something like that. I use the CalSheet app, right? And it's very, very easy. It's very seamless. You can easily fund it. You can have all sorts of different bets. I read through this methodology document of these NHL ETFs. And there's 55 different inputs. So basically- 55?
turns.zh: 对，我们团队里一直在争论这个问题。一般来说，一只 ETF 之所以成功，是因为它让某件事变得更简单，对吧？比如让你能接触到加密货币、拉美的债券之类的。我用 Kalshi 的 App，非常非常方便，无缝顺畅，充值也容易，可以下各种各样的注。我把这些 NHL ETF 的方法论文档整个读了一遍，里面有 55 个不同的输入指标。所以基本上——55 个？

turns.en: It's crazy. What do they count as inputs?
turns.zh: 太夸张了。他们把什么算作输入指标？

turns.en: There's like intra-game stats. So like basically if there's a penalty, right? Or how many goals your team scores, how many blocks your goalie has, all that impacts the score. Then there's sort of end of month stats. How many, are they on a win streak, right? All these things sort of factor in. So it's very, very complicated. Some of the things that I think about is like, well, a lot of times when the game is on, the market's closed, right? And something with like cow sheet, that's always continuously running, right? 24 hours a day, you can bet during the games. I feel like when you're watching a game, you want to maybe make bets in that moment. This is a little bit harder with the ETF. So this is maybe a longer term play. Like a diehard fan. Yeah, exactly. You really love this team.
turns.zh: 有比赛进行中的实时数据，比如有没有罚下、你的球队进了几个球、守门员扑救了几次，这些都会影响指数。然后还有月度层面的数据，比如球队有没有连胜之类的，都会算进去。所以是非常非常复杂的。我会想到的一些问题是，比赛在进行时，股市往往是关着的，对吧？而 Kalshi 这类平台是全天候 24 小时不停运行的，你可以在比赛过程中下注。我觉得你在看比赛的时候，往往会想当场下注，用 ETF 就有点难做到。所以这也许更适合长线操作，适合那种死忠球迷。对，没错。你是真的爱这支球队。

turns.en: This is our year.
turns.zh: 今年就是我们的年。

turns.en: Yeah, and you buy the jersey and you buy the ETF, I guess.
turns.zh: 对，你会买球衣，然后大概也会买这只 ETF。

turns.en: Maybe the shares of the ETF come with jerseys that you buy.
turns.zh: 也许买这只 ETF 的股份还送球衣。

turns.en: That's actually a pretty good selling point. I would buy the ETF just for the jersey.
turns.zh: 这其实是个挺不错的卖点。为了球衣我都愿意买这只 ETF。

turns.en: We're going to be in the merch business, but also in investment management. So why... Why the NHL again? Is this just because CME has some hockey heads and decided to do some futures for the NHL?
turns.zh: 那我们既要进军周边商品业务，又要搞投资管理。那么为什么……再说一次，为什么是 NHL？是不是仅仅因为 CME 内部有些冰球爱好者，就决定给 NHL 做一些期货？

turns.en: That's a good question. I don't know. I'm thinking it was probably easier to get a licensing agreement with the NHL versus the NBA and the NFL. Also, the hockey season is pretty long. I know MLB is longer, but I think they had to start with a season that's really long versus the NFL. So yeah, I think this is why they started with the NHL teams. I know probably most people are looking at it like, well, why NHL? But I think this is probably the reason why they went with that one.
turns.zh: 这是个好问题，我也不清楚。我猜可能是因为跟 NHL 谈授权协议比跟 NBA、NFL 谈更容易。另外，冰球赛季挺长的。我知道 MLB 赛季更长，但相比 NFL，他们得选一个赛季足够长的联赛来起步。所以 yeah，我觉得这就是他们从 NHL 球队开始的原因。大多数人可能会想：为什么偏偏是 NHL？但我觉得这大概就是他们选 NHL 的理由。

turns.en: But maybe it makes a good case study to start with that too. And then you can take the results to the big guys. Yeah, for sure.
turns.zh: 但也许从 NHL 开始也是个不错的案例研究，然后你可以拿着这个结果去谈那些大联盟。对，肯定是的。

turns.en: If this does well, if anything, probably NBA and NFL will be even more popular, right? So I think this is a good sort of put, you know, dip your toe in the water, see how these work, see if there's any kind of remote interest.
turns.zh: 如果这些 ETF 表现好，那 NBA 和 NFL 大概率会更受欢迎，对吧？所以我觉得这是一个不错的试水方式——先探探路，看看这些 ETF 到底怎么运作，看看是不是真的哪怕有一点点兴趣。

turns.en: Okay. So just a reminder, where does the filing go from here? It's hitting the SEC and now it's going to enter a little bit of autopsy period?
turns.zh: 好的。那么给大家提示一下，这些申报接下来会走什么流程？交给 SEC，然后进入一段审查期？

turns.en: For sure. They're going to get, you know, there could be comments. The thing is, while this is probably a good likelihood is because it's CME backed, right? These futures already exist, which are approved. So with that, I think there's probably a good likelihood these could get launched. If there wasn't any sort of backing like that, I would probably be a little bit more skeptical. But I think these have a pretty good chance of getting approved.
turns.zh: 没错。SEC 可能会有反馈意见之类的。关键在于，这批 ETF 获批的可能性比较大，是因为背后有 CME 撑着，对吧？相关的期货产品已经存在，也已经获批了。有这个基础在，我觉得这些 ETF 有相当不错的机会落地。如果没有这样的背书，我可能会更怀疑一些。但我认为它们通过审批的可能性挺大。

turns.en: And there are 32 of them because there's one per team.
turns.zh: 总共 32 只，因为每支球队对应一只。

turns.en: Yep, exactly.
turns.zh: 对，没错。

turns.en: If we don't have enough ETFs already.
turns.zh: 就好像我们现有的 ETF 还不够多似的。

turns.en: I can't wait to see what the tickers are. They've got to be like all over the place. Okay, so the CME development with NHL. and these new ETF filings is certainly like maybe one type of way that ETFs are getting into sports. But there's other things that have been happening this year. Why is all of this happening in the first place? And like, why are ETFs even looking at sports as like sort of this next great frontier?
turns.zh: 我迫不及待想看看这些 ETF 的代码会是什么样，肯定五花八门。好，那么 CME 跟 NHL 的合作以及这些新的 ETF 申报，当然是 ETF 进军体育领域的一种方式。但今年还有其他动作也在发生。为什么会出现这一切？为什么 ETF 会把体育视为下一个大蓝海？

turns.en: So recently, there was this really great Bloomberg News article, and it was actually looking at Gen Z's sort of view of asset classes and a lot of them were thinking of sports betting as an asset class right so actually looking at this not only for fun but actually like i'm going to put real money into this i'm going to add this as an investment so i think that is happening along with just etf filings are getting a little crazy yeah right and.
turns.zh: 最近 Bloomberg News 有一篇很棒的报道，讲的是 Z 世代对资产类别的看法，很多年轻人已经把体育博彩当成一种资产类别。也就是说，他们不只是把它当作娱乐，而是真的会投入真金白银，把它当成一项投资。我觉得这种趋势在发生，同时 ETF 申报也开始变得越来越疯狂，对吧？然后……

turns.en: That's what it something's happened maybe it was bitcoin where it was just like you know what we really can put anything into an etf And now it's like, how much of the sports universe can we put into it? Oh, totally.
turns.zh: 感觉是发生了某种转变——也许是 Bitcoin 那波让大家意识到：你知道吗，我们真的可以把任何东西塞进一只 ETF 里。现在的问题变成了：体育这块 universe 里我们能塞进去多少？哦，完全同意。

turns.en: They put single stocks, right? So we're back to this very speculative investing culture. People want to make bigger, bigger bets. They're willing to go more all in on stuff. And I think you know, leverage is sort of tapped out. They have all these single stock ones. Now it's like sports betting. And this coincides with the growth of things like Polymarket and CalSheet, right? And you're seeing sort of the volumes there. So I think if they just put in the ETF, it's like, well... And I don't know how they'll leapfrog this, but let's say if you're underage, right, and you can't open a sports betting account or a sports book, you could buy an ETF, right? That sort of kind of does the same thing. Yeah, so I think this is just feeding that behavior.
turns.zh: 他们连单一股票 ETF 都做出来了，对吧？所以我们又回到了那种非常投机化的投资文化。人们想下更大的注，愿意 all in。我觉得杠杆类产品基本上已经做到头了，各种单一股票杠杆 ETF 都有了。现在轮到体育博彩了。这跟 Polymarket、Kalshi 这类平台的崛起是同步的，你能看到它们的交易量在增长。所以我觉得如果把这些东西塞进 ETF，就……我不知道他们会怎么绕过限制，但假设你还没到法定年龄，不能开体育博彩账户或去体育博彩公司，那你可以买 ETF，对吧？效果其实差不多。所以我觉得这就是在助长那种行为。

turns.en: So let's just lay out the various things that are also in filing stage. So there's the futures-based stuff that the NHL is doing, prediction markets, and what's the likelihood of that in Bloomberg Intelligence? You guys would classify that as a novel idea, right?
turns.zh: 那我们把处于申报阶段的各类产品梳理一下。有 NHL 那种基于期货的，还有预测市场类的。从 Bloomberg Intelligence 的角度看，这些获批的可能性如何？你们会把预测市场类归为新颖创意，对吧？

turns.en: Yeah. And I think the NHL ones are novel too. Novel too.
turns.zh: 对。而且我觉得 NHL 那批也算新颖。也算新颖。

turns.en: Okay.
turns.zh: 好。

turns.en: Yes. So this one, I know it's a fine line between like prediction markets and like what these NHL ones are doing versus like the prediction ones more binary, right? So you're betting on a Super Bowl winner. If that happens or it doesn't happen, you're going to win or lose all your money.
turns.zh: 是的。这里面，预测市场和 NHL 那批 ETF 之间其实界限很微妙，而预测市场类产品更偏二元化，对吧？比如你押 Super Bowl 冠军，要么发生要么不发生，你要么赢光要么输光。

turns.en: That's it.
turns.zh: 就这样。

turns.en: Some of the issues are starting to do these too. And not only with sports, with other like sort of economic news too, but- Yeah.
turns.zh: 一些发行商也开始做这类产品。而且不只是体育，还有其他跟经济新闻挂钩的，但——对。

turns.en: The Fed would be central to some of these, I think.
turns.zh: 我觉得 Fed 会是其中一些产品的核心标的。

turns.en: Yeah, exactly. Or a recession, things like that. But yeah, you can pick the Super Bowl winner, which again, we're obviously very pro-ETF, right? I don't see the reason why you would do that versus doing it on CalSheet. I don't understand what advantage the ETF is really giving you. But yeah, these are in filing. Nothing's been approved yet. Those ones I think could see more skepticism from the SEC. Again, these are all going to be backed by Kalshi and stuff. Yeah, there's sort of that end of the sports betting spectrum happening as well.
turns.zh: 对，没错。或者经济衰退之类的。是的，你可以押 Super Bowl 冠军。但再说一次，我们显然是非常支持 ETF 的，对吧？我看不出为什么要用 ETF 来做，而不是直接在 Kalshi 上做。我不明白 ETF 到底能给你什么额外优势。总之这些还在申报阶段，还没批下来。我觉得这类产品可能会遭到 SEC 更多的质疑。同样，这些产品背后也是靠 Kalshi 之类的平台支撑。所以说，体育博彩光谱的另一端也在发生这些动作。

turns.en: And then the other one that we, I think, have briefly mentioned previously, the subversive all-season sports ETF, yet another filing. Great Matt Levine column about it in Money Stuff a couple months ago. What's that strategy look like?
turns.zh: 然后是另一只我们之前简单提过的——Subversive All-Season Sports ETF，也是一份新的申报。几个月前 Matt Levine 在 Money Stuff 专栏里写过一篇很棒的文章。这个策略具体是什么样的？

turns.en: This is actually kind of brilliant because I think they've This PM found a way that you could just fund their gambling habits, right? So, this one essentially you would be giving your money to this fund and they'd be making all these different bets, right? Based on some algorithm or they're looking where maybe odds might be.
turns.zh: 这个其实挺天才的，因为我觉得这位基金经理找到了一种办法，能让投资者为他的赌瘾买单，对吧？基本上就是你把钱交给这只基金，他们会去做各种各样的下注，可能基于某种算法，或者去寻找赔率错位的机会。

turns.en: It's literally a sports book.
turns.zh: 这不就是活脱脱一个体育博彩公司吗？

turns.en: Yeah, exactly. And then so, this PM would make the decisions for you. So, it's almost like a basket of bets, right? So, they'll be using some algorithm to figure out what these odds aren't right. We actually think you should bet on this. But again... If I'm using the app, I think part of the most fun of betting is I want that rush of betting. I don't go to Vegas and give you my money to gamble.
turns.zh: 对，没错。这位基金经理会替你做决定，所以基本上就是一篮子赌注，对吧？他们会用某种算法来判断赔率不合理的地方——'我们真的觉得你应该押这个'。但话说回来……如果是我自己用 App 下注，我觉得下注最好玩的一部分就是那种肾上腺素飙升的刺激感。我不会跑去 Vegas 把钱交给别人替我赌。

turns.en: I mean, I could encourage you to do that. It's more fun for me that way.
turns.zh: 我是说，我可以鼓励你那样做。对我来说那样更好玩。

turns.en: I don't know. Don't you want to go put the numbers down on the roulette table? I want someone else to do it.
turns.zh: 我不知道。你难道不想亲自去轮盘桌上下注吗？我倒希望别人替我做。

turns.en: I'm going to give you money and you can use your Calchi to do it for me.
turns.zh: 我会把钱给你，让你用你的 Kalshi 替我下注。

turns.en: I don't want to watch someone else have all the fun. So that's part of the... The reason why, this could maybe do okay.
turns.zh: 我可不想看着别人玩得那么开心。所以这也是……这只 ETF 也许能表现还行的原因之一。

turns.en: Well, I mean, if he's really good at picking winners, like, I mean, it could work out.
turns.zh: 嗯，我是说，如果他真的擅长挑赢家，那结果可能不错。

turns.en: Eric had this great analogy. Remember the movie Casino? Sam Rothstein, right? He's basically like him. And he's like the best, like, bookie in the country. So, like, if he was running an ETF, I don't know, I'd probably give him money to run. But yeah, and so there's that as well to sort of a more diversified, quote unquote, basket of bets that they're making.
turns.zh: Eric 有一个很棒的比喻。还记得电影《Casino》里的 Sam Rothstein 吗？他基本上就是那种人——全国最厉害的庄家。所以如果让他来管理一只 ETF，我不知道，我大概愿意把钱交给他打理。是的，所以这只 ETF 也有这种特点——他们做的是一篮子更加'多元化'（打个引号）的赌注。

turns.en: How do you think that SEC will look at that one in the novelty scale?
turns.zh: 你觉得 SEC 会从新颖性这个角度怎么看这只 ETF？

turns.en: That one, I think, could probably more likelihood than the prediction markets one. Again, this is all on a scale. That one, maybe. And I can actually see people making the case that this is somehow uncorrelated asset class, right? I'm just doing an allocation of these random bets and Over the long term, maybe it's uncorrelated and it makes money for me. So I could see it from that angle. Again, I think that's a stretch. Yeah, that's one. It's a little bit more diversified. I think maybe has a better chance of having some success.
turns.zh: 这只的话，我觉得获批可能性大概比预测市场类的高。当然这都是相对而言。也许吧。我确实能理解有人会说这类产品是某种非相关资产类别，对吧？'我只是在这些随机赌注上做配置，长期来看也许它跟其他资产不相关，还能给我赚钱。'我能理解这种说法。当然，我觉得这个说法有点牵强。总之这只 ETF 稍微更分散一些，我觉得它成功的机会也许更大一些。

turns.en: Okay, just to continue to try and zoom out a little bit. What's actually happening here, to me, it feels like we're at yet another, you know, highs of a bull market. And there's a thing that starts to happen, which is, things get really experimental and we saw it previously a couple of years ago and it feels like we're back there. What do you think of that?
turns.zh: 好，我们再拉远一点看。这里到底发生了什么？对我来说，感觉我们又处在一个牛市的新高点。这时候会出现一种现象——产品开始变得非常实验性，我们几年前见过一次，现在感觉又回到了那个时候。你怎么看？

turns.en: Oh, I mean, we always, we've wanted a bull market. This is what it looks like, right? Yeah. You kind of start to get these filings that are, you know, they're really pushing the envelope and I've learned not to dismiss these and they might sound ridiculous. And we thought stuff sounded ridiculous five years ago and now they're like, yeah, they're like normal and they're big businesses in the ETF market. So, You know, even the SEC, it's not their job to tell you.
turns.zh: 噢，我是说，我们一直都想要牛市，这就是牛市的样子，对吧？你会开始看到这些非常挑战极限的申报文件。我已经学会了不轻易否定它们，即便它们听起来很荒唐。五年前我们也觉得有些东西听起来很荒唐，但现在它们已经变得稀松平常，甚至成了 ETF 市场里的大生意。所以，即便是 SEC，也不是他们的职责来告诉你……

turns.en: If it's wise.
turns.zh: 这样做是否明智。

turns.en: They told us this recently. It's not their job. It's not my job to tell you. We're not judging. Yeah, exactly. Does it help by bringing these products into the market? No, it encourages a lot of bad behavior, but we're not here to tell you that. But again, you know, I think it also just shows how much people want stuff in an ETF, right? And just how much the ETF has grown and what they're willing to put into it. But yeah, we've totally just moved away from broad diversified baskets of stocks. Now you're literally just picking specific things.
turns.zh: 他们最近就是这么说的。这不是他们的职责。'不是我的职责来告诉你，我们不做评判。'对，没错。'把这些产品带到市场上是不是好事？不，它助长了很多糟糕的行为，但我们不是来告诉你这些的。'但话说回来，我觉得这也反映了人们有多想把各种东西装进 ETF，对吧？也体现了 ETF 已经发展到什么程度、人们愿意把什么东西塞进 ETF。总之，我们已经彻底告别了那种广泛分散的股票组合。现在你就是在一选一选具体的东西。

turns.en: Well, hopefully it's both and maybe one more than the other. But it's also just worth mentioning though, I mean, maybe part of the reason for all of this is in your Calci update, you might be betting with $ 100, but once you get into a brokerage, there's a lot more money that you can be playing with.
turns.zh: 嗯，希望是两者兼有，也许其中一方更多一些。不过也值得一提的是，也许这一切背后的部分原因是——在 Kalshi 上你可能只押 100 美元，但一旦进入券商账户，你能玩的钱就多得多。

turns.en: Oh, yeah, no, that's a great point. And think about then options and stuff tied around that, right? So think about how insane just 2x levered single stocks are. There's options on those, right, that are way more levered. So, you know, if these hit and now you could have options around these and you have this whole ecosystem built around it, it makes it very easy, you know, to open up in your account. Yeah, yeah, it's definitely a pretty interesting time.
turns.zh: 噢，对，这个观点很棒。再想想围绕它的期权之类的东西，对吧？想想 2 倍杠杆的单一股票 ETF 已经够疯狂了，还有基于它们的期权，杠杆更高。所以如果这些体育类 ETF 落地，然后你又能围绕它们做期权，就有了一整个生态系统，让你在自己的账户里玩起来非常容易。是的，是的，这绝对是一个非常有意思的时代。

turns.en: All right. More followings to watch. Ethan, thanks for joining me on Trades.
turns.zh: 好的。后续还有更多申报值得关注。Ethan，谢谢你来做客 Trillions。

turns.en: Thanks for having me on.
turns.zh: 谢谢邀请。

We'd love to hear from you. Hit us up on social. Trillions is produced by Magnus Hendriksen and Kishav Pandya. Amy Keene is our executive producer. Cheryl Brumley is the head of Bloomberg Podcasts.
turns.zh: 感谢收听 Trillions。下次再见之前，你可以在 Bloomberg Terminal、Bloomberg.com、Apple Podcasts、Spotify 或任何你喜欢的平台上找到我们。我们很想听到你的声音，来社交媒体上找我们聊。Trillions 由 Magnus Hendriksen 和 Kishav Pandya 制作，Amy Keene 是我们的执行制作人，Cheryl Brumley 是 Bloomberg Podcasts 的负责人。

turns.en: Bye.
turns.zh: 再见。
